result.title: Interference Bounds and Merge-Aware Training Dynamics for Composable Fine-Tuned Models
result.comment: Submitted to a journal. The journal info will be confirmed once the paper is accepted
result.summary: Combining fine-tuned models by composing their parameter updates has become a standard alternative to multi-task training. We formalize composability as a property of a collection of task vectors and prove that the excess loss of the merged model is controlled by an interference functional of the cross-task curvature overlap and the signed alignment of the updates. In the quadratic regime this functional equals the excess loss, giving a criterion that is necessary as well as sufficient and that measures the angle between task vectors in the curvature metric rather than the Euclidean one. Fine-tuning under a curvature-guided regularizer -- constructed from curvature statistics of the kind memory-efficient optimizers maintain -- keeps displacement in the base curvature metric below a ceiling set by the penalty coefficient at every iterate, at the standard $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ non-convex rate. Under a single Loewner comparison between the base statistic and the task curvatures, this control converts into a ceiling on the interference functional, inversely proportional to the penalty coefficient, so that the curvature term of the bound is controlled during training. A first-order term, present because regularized solutions are not stationary for the task loss, is not reduced in the same way. Experiments on an exact non-quadratic model confirm the budget and the ceiling, show the first-order term dominating for strong penalties, and find the curvature-guided penalty slightly better than an isotropic one. In a three-seed transformer study the functional is rank-correlated with merging degradation, but no more strongly than the Euclidean displacement norm.

AI.brief_summary: 论文将微调模型的组合性形式化为任务向量集合的性质，证明合并模型的超额损失由跨任务曲率重叠与更新符号对齐构成的干涉泛函控制，并提出曲率引导正则项在训练中压低该泛函，用二次、非二次模型及 Transformer 实验检验界与排序关系。
AI.relevance_reason: 其“曲率度量下的夹角与干涉泛函”属于表示几何视角，可能与多个 latent 推理模块或推理行为的叠加干扰问题相关；但对象是参数更新而非推理期状态，能否迁移到 LVR 组合与贡献分配尚需核查。
